en: This is an old postcard with a decorative border, a Swedish postage stamp, and handwritten text. The front features three black-and-white photographs framed in ornate designs: a central square with a fountain and large building, an overview of a coastal city, and a church with a tall spire beside other grand buildings. The reverse side is reserved for correspondence and address, written in Swedish.
